title: 第729章 江南月各有安排第728章 十一艘直取江南
slug: 玄幻真龙为骨我刀问天下
content_zh:
敲定好策略之后，三尊老人无声无息的消失了，仿佛从未出现过。
相柳不紧不慢的拿起一卷兵书，不是做做样子，而是认认真真的看了起来，看到精妙处，甚至还会提笔写下自己的理解。
这是他在江南求学时养成的习惯，为此还得了先生陈子初好一阵夸赞，赏了他一串糖葫芦，甜滋滋的那种。
没看几卷，相柳便乏了。
他看着窗外那形似教书先生的黑云陷入了恍惚，真像先生啊。
渐渐的，他不由得想起了江南那段短暂而又充实的时光，想起了那串晶莹剔透，甜进心间的糖葫芦。
他放下手中书卷，用只能自己听到的声音呢喃道：“先生，你不认我这个学生没关系，我心底里却还是认您的，没有你的谆谆教诲，安能有我相柳今天？”
“陆去疾灭了青云书院，杀了您，这份仇天下没有人记得，我这个记名弟子却是不能忘记，你放心，江南总司一个都逃不掉。”
这最后几个字，相柳咬字极重。
陈子初死了，他很生气，真的很生气。
虽然陈子初不认他这个学生，甚至多次对他这个学生大打出手。
但他不恨陈子初，因为那是大义使然，更因为当初陈子初在江南之时对他的倾囊相授。
可以说，没有陈子初就没有他相柳今天，他又怎么会恨呢？
他恨的只有一人，那便是陆去疾。
他心底里最尊敬的先生陈子初死在陆去疾手中，跟随他多年垂野也死在了陆去疾手中！
他心底里恨不得把陆去疾千刀万剐。
但现在他做不到，没错，就是做不到，陆去疾实在太诡异了，上次在诗剑李家鬼上身，差点把三尊六境大妖打死。
这让他对陆去疾忌惮到了极致，甚至还产生了一抹畏惧，他有种无力感，甚至有些想不通，世上怎会有这么难杀的人。
“陆去疾，杀不了你，我还杀不了其它人吗？”
“你拥有的还是太多了，我要你看着你的亲朋好友一个个死去，让你尝尝孤家寡人的滋味。”

相柳凛然一笑，旋即看了一眼暗角的侍卫，下令道：
“通知伯谦将那银蛇公子等人灭了，七十二妖官全部压入幽州境内，争取灭了那大奉太子。”
闻言，站在的暗角的侍卫面无表情，先是单膝下跪，而后对着相柳抱拳道：“得令。”
旋即，其化作一道残影掠出飞舟，化作一只三足乌径直飞向大虞益州，也就是如今的妖族大营。
相柳望着三足乌离去的背影，小声沉吟道：“这三足乌修为不弱，办事也麻利，当个参将实在可惜了，以后得多提拔一下，妖庭始终是孤的妖庭，妖官的位置不能让四大妖族全部占据……”
……
时值冬季。
天上的明月格外清冷。
洒下万缕刺骨的清辉不说，还杀得百草低头。
江南总司之内恍若白昼，一间间屋子灯火通明，传递情报的黄衣使来来往往，愣是将那长长的门槛踩碎了。
数以百计的红雀从四面八方飞入草堂，每一只红雀的爪子上都系着一个小竹筒，里面装着的情报记录了妖族的一举一动。
content_en:
After finalizing the strategy, the three old men disappeared silently, as if they had never appeared.
Xiang Liu picked up a volume of military literature unhurriedly, not just for show, but to read it carefully. When he saw the subtleties, he even wrote down his own understanding.
This was a habit he developed when he was studying in Jiangnan. For this, his teacher Chen Zichu praised him a lot and gave him a bunch of candied haws, which was so sweet.
After reading a few volumes, Xiang Liu felt tired.
He looked out the window at the black cloud that looked like a teacher and fell into a trance. He really looked like a teacher.
Gradually, he couldn't help but think of the short but fulfilling time in Jiangnan, and the string of crystal-clear candied haws, which were sweet to the heart.
He put down the book in his hand and murmured in a voice that could only be heard by himself: "Sir, it doesn't matter if you don't recognize me as a student, but I still recognize you in my heart. Without your sincere teachings, would I be here today?"
"Lu Quji destroyed Qingyun Academy and killed you. No one in the world will remember this hatred, but I, the registered disciple, cannot forget it. Don't worry, no one from the Jiangnan General Division can escape."
These last few words are very emphasized by Xiang Liu.
Chen Zichu died, and he was very angry, really angry.
Although Chen Zichu did not recognize him as a student and even beat him as a student many times.
But he didn't hate Chen Zichu, because it was out of righteousness, and even more because Chen Zichu gave him everything he had when he was in Jiangnan.
It can be said that without Chen Zichu, there would be no Xiang Liu today. How could he hate it?
There was only one person he hated, and that was Lu Quji.
Chen Zichu, the gentleman he respected most in his heart, died in the hands of Lu Quji, and Chui Ye, who had followed him for many years, also died in the hands of Lu Quji!
Deep in his heart, he wished he could cut Lu Quji into pieces with a thousand knives.
But now he can't do it, yes, he just can't do it. Lu Quji is too weird. Last time, he almost killed three six-level monsters when he was possessed by the Li family ghost in Shijian.
This made him extremely wary of Lu Quji, and even gave him a sense of fear. He felt powerless, and even couldn't figure out how there could be such a difficult person to kill in the world.
"Lu Quji, if I can't kill you, why can't I kill others?"
"You still have too much. I want you to watch your relatives and friends die one by one, so that you can taste what it's like to be alone."
Xiang Liu smiled solemnly, then glanced at the guard in the dark corner and ordered:
"Inform Bo Qian to kill Mr. Silver Snake and others. All seventy-two demon officials will press into Youzhou and try to kill Prince Dafeng."
Hearing this, the guard standing in the dark corner had no expression on his face. He knelt down on one knee first, then clasped his fist towards Xiang Liu and said, "I have the order."
Immediately, it turned into an afterimage and flew out of the flying boat, turning into a three-legged crow and flying straight to Dayu Yizhou, which is now the Demon Clan's camp.
Xiang Liu looked at the departing back of the Three-Legged Crow and muttered in a low voice: "This Three-Legged Crow is not weak in cultivation and can handle things quickly. It is a pity to be a general. I will have to promote him more in the future. The Demon Court will always be a lonely Demon Court. The position of the Demon Officer cannot be occupied by all four demon clans..."
…
It's winter.
The bright moon in the sky is particularly cold.
Not only did it shed thousands of biting rays of light, it also made Baicao bow his head.
It was like daytime inside the Jiangnan General Division, and the rooms were brightly lit. The envoys in yellow who conveyed information came and went, and the long threshold was crushed to pieces.
Hundreds of red sparrows flew into the thatched cottage from all directions, and each cardinal had a small bamboo tube tied to its paw, which contained information that recorded every move of the demon clan.
